scripts.build: bun run client && bun run --cwd deploy build
scripts.build:brand: uv run --no-project --exclude-newer 2026-09-26 --with fonttools==4.66.0 --with brotli==1.2.0 python brand/build.py
scripts.deploy: bun run client && bun run --cwd deploy deploy
scripts.dev: bun run client && cd deploy && mise exec -- cf dev
scripts.build:font: bun -e "import { LANDING_HTML } from './landing'; process.stdout.write(LANDING_HTML)" | uv run --no-project --exclude-newer 2026-09-26 --with fonttools==4.66.0 --with brotli==1.2.0 python brand/home_font.py
scripts.build:font:check: bun -e "import { LANDING_HTML } from './landing'; process.stdout.write(LANDING_HTML)" | uv run --no-project --exclude-newer 2026-09-26 --with fonttools==4.66.0 --with brotli==1.2.0 python brand/home_font.py --check
scripts.build:origin: uv run --no-project --exclude-newer 2026-10-09 --with pypdfium2==5.14.0 --with pillow==12.3.0 python brand/home_origin.py
